身体里的细胞为什么长得不一样？: Why do body cells have different shapes?
皮肤细胞连成保护层，肌肉纤维能收缩，神经元把信息传向远处。同样叫细胞，本领却不一: Skin cells build a barrier, muscle fibres contract, and neurons pass information over long distances. All are cells, with different abilities.
比较皮肤、肌肉与神经元，观察形状怎样帮助它们保护、运动和传递信息。: Compare skin, muscle and neurons. See how structure supports protection, movement and communication.
这是三类代表结构的比较，不是人体全部细胞清单。大小、颜色、速度和图中层数均为示意: These are three representative structures, not a complete inventory of body cells. Size, colour, speed and layer counts are illustrative, without the staining meaning of a micrograph. The muscle view combines fibres with one sarcomere to show sliding, not shortening filaments; forces that restore length are not modeled. The neuron example uses a myelinated axon and chemical synapse, not every neuronal form.
细胞与组织的互动示意图: Interactive illustration of cells and tissues
观察层层相接的细胞。外面的标记遇到完整表面停住了；屏障并不是只有一颗细胞在工作。: Observe cells joined in layers. External markers stop at the intact surface; the barrier is not the work of one cell alone.
皮肤表皮里，许多细胞相接排列。靠外的细胞逐渐扁平、角化，参与形成保护屏障。: Many cells join to form the epidermis. Cells nearer the surface flatten and become cornified, contributing to a protective barrier.
这里选定的外来颗粒被完整表面挡住。皮肤不是一堵完全不透任何东西的墙，但能减少许多: The selected particles are blocked by the intact surface. Skin is not impermeable to everything, but it limits many external materials and water loss.
表皮深处有细胞分裂并向表面补充。最外层角化细胞没有细胞核，不能把每一层都当成一样: Cells deeper in the epidermis divide and replenish the surface. The outermost cornified cells lack nuclei; not every layer consists of identical living cells.
拖到中间看收缩，再拖到最后看放松。放大图里的细丝没有变短，而是彼此滑动，重叠增加: Scrub to the middle for contraction and to the end for relaxation. In the close view, filaments slide and overlap more; the filaments themselves do not shorten.
一条骨骼肌纤维就是一个很长的细胞，通常有多个细胞核。里面排着许多参与收缩的结构。: A skeletal muscle fibre is one very long cell, usually with multiple nuclei. It contains many structures involved in contraction.
收到适合的信号后，钙离子参与调节，肌动蛋白与肌球蛋白相互作用。这里仅把相对滑动放: Following an appropriate signal, calcium helps regulate interactions between actin and myosin. This close view isolates their relative sliding.
收缩需要能量；停止激活后，肌纤维可以放松。实际恢复长度还受到其他肌肉、弹性和外部: Contraction uses energy. After activation stops, the fibre can relax. Its actual return in length also depends on other muscles, elasticity and external loads.
沿长长的轴突追踪亮点，再看突触附近的小点。亮点是信号位置标记，并不是在神经里奔跑: Follow the bright marker along the axon, then watch the small dots near the synapse. The bright spot marks a signal; it is not a ball running inside a nerve.
神经元有细胞体和突起。很多树突参与接收信息，轴突可以把信号传到较远的位置。: A neuron has a cell body and extensions. Many dendrites receive information, while an axon can carry signals farther away.
信号沿膜传开: A signal spreads along the membrane
离子通过膜上的通道，形成沿轴突传播的电变化。图中髓鞘来自其他细胞，能帮助某些轴突: Ions pass through membrane channels, producing an electrical change that travels along the axon. Myelin comes from other cells and speeds conduction in some axons.
在这个化学突触例子中，末梢释放递质。递质跨过很窄的间隙，影响下一个细胞，而不是两: In this chemical-synapse example, the ending releases neurotransmitter. It crosses a tiny gap and affects the next cell; the two cells do not form one continuous pipe.
细胞的长短、排列、内部结构和连接方式，都与它做的事有关。形状不是按任务临时随意换: Length, arrangement, internal structures and connections all support function. Cells do not simply switch costumes to take a new job.
皮肤、肌肉和神经组织都不只有图中挑出的细胞。支持细胞、血管和细胞外物质也很重要。: Skin, muscle and nervous tissues contain more than the selected cells shown. Supporting cells, vessels and extracellular material also matter.
拿起一块积木时，神经传信息、肌肉产生力，皮肤保护表面；血液还持续运输氧气和营养。: When you pick up a block, nerves convey information, muscles generate force, and skin protects the surface. Blood continually carries oxygen and nutrients.
红细胞留在血管内: Red cells stay inside the vessel
